statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was directly mapped from the single line item 'Depreciation and amortization' in the operating activities section of the cash flow statement. No other elements from the statement or supplementary tables were required to make up this total. The supplementary tables contain details on operating leases and parent company cash flows, but the depreciation and amortization expense for the consolidated entity is fully captured in the primary statement line item.
